drives: RVND oversight via workspace_workflow op=approval_request/approval_decide/approval_resolve/approval_delegate/approval_list + signed chain
grounding: ../../references/ingest-cascade.md; the human terminal of the shared graph - reads the pending decisions the engine produced, proposes no constructs; a release is a fresh activation with its own token/trace
cascade: local-first: reads the RVND engine's precise, signable pending verdict when present; else the coarse, advisory upstream graph the LLM enriched - the human decision is captured but degraded (unsigned, unenforced) until the engine ratifies. Never the reverse.
invariants: cascade local-first - operates the one shared dimensioned Subgraph (never a bespoke shape); the engine's pending verdict wins when present, the LLM-enriched upstream is the labelled degraded fallback
the person decides; the skill records - no recommendation or nudge
two modes, never collapsed: ratification (approve/deny) vs residual-origination (>=2 unranked alternatives, no default, never approve/reject)
the underlying verdict (human/reserved/refused/prohibited) is preserved, not flattened to hold
whether an approval COUNTS is the projection's call
a loosening approval is inert without a named approver and rationale
a reserved act cannot run automatically
provenance: Authored for loomground; drives the AGPL-3.0-only RVND governance server. No third-party skill source.
notes: Progressive-disclosure: lean SKILL.md + references/ pair + shared plugin references.
review: Validated against the declared compatible RVND release range.
